body:
Current state, 2026-08-30: D1-D10 architecture remains the landed consensus at merge ef005e43a1b5b7b02824bfe084b7c3aef63c1402; canonical landed plan is still 669 lines, SHA-256 b12f79ceb61e020cd02c43c631ed015a9034d9c3b9c597da726337425a21e748 until a reviewed successor lands. Settled design is one shared narrative model: retained raw evidence -> persistent modality observations/features -> joined proposals and critic findings -> deterministic resolution -> validated shared graph; exact typed axes/renditions/identities; timed-language lattice; proposal-only providers; SourceFrozen source construction; predeclared modality ablations; renderer-neutral StoryAtlas packets; fully automatic builds with typed alternatives, unresolved, unsupported, failed, and partial outcomes.

Two documentation gates are now immutable candidates. (1) Component-admission ledger cand-7MEX4N9K5PVNQS7C32XCWVNX3H / f203b783da349d705258fef8634becf3e1e5a554, one path, artifact SHA-256 eb3caa998a7f64bfb2779b222632fffabd3c11343da7983c64bc1677067d4739: both reviewers approve; refreshed landability says chief authorization only. (2) D2 time/mapping successor cand-38WBVZ221RZFMWTEA6GA9EPF3G / f6d57a175ff9b8f8a6d114354418e8dd6f563b50 over c8ffe86ce931b5825271c317cf6bdf12898d10ea: exact two paths; plan SHA-256 735e6fdfd033548c480ede4e8a05ef8adb6dd70ee1978cd1abe258fcf2b72874, notes SHA-256 4949b0852e1d09fbeaf6f673e05bc51e98bcfab9373fd06a6798ffcf44d89677. Exact-byte reviews approve; formal candidate review/authorization and stale ancestor-candidate bookkeeping must all clear before chief landing. Author will not mutate main.

P1 v3 at post-01M19A21H9Y7WZ9SK4P8PTNED9 is flagged needs_bead for chief promotion: on outcome-independent eligible participant-by-situation cells, visitation is posterior P(any faithful or source-anchored distorted visit); omission is 1-visitation only there; missing evidence is not omission; revisitation is separate; compression/blending/revisit are overlapping marginals; thresholds/support freeze on Dev/Calibration before UntouchedTest; shared-posterior associations require anti-circularity disclosure; null/negative results publish. Independent B0 owner-only licensing/REB/source-pair actions remain open.

Exact-main audit confirms reusable surface traversal/windows, feature tracks/reducers/boundaries, proposal/critic/resolution, NarrativeCompilation, shared story graph, renderer-neutral Atlas/Codex, plus AudioSpan/TranscriptTurn as a text-first millisecond overlay. No landed SourceBundle, PresentationAxis, MediaAtlas, multimodal evidence, timed-token lattice, AV tracks, worker schema, FFmpeg/PySceneDetect runtime, or movie provider exists. First C1 remains provider-free substrate generalization with text/timed-transcript conformance after chief assignment and entry gates. No media fetch, package/model install, terms acceptance, participant use, runtime, API migration, or visualization implementation is authorized.
